verdict.rationale: Wrike's own docs say teams can build custom AI agents that handle triaging and everyday tasks, so AI triage is a first-party capability. However, it rests on a single marketing-level mention, and it requires users to build and configure their own agents. Prioritization of incoming bugs and tasks is not clearly documented; the 'mobile inbox prioritization' feature refers to the inbox, not work items. Missing for 10: detailed docs on automatic bug and task triage behavior, documented AI prioritization of incoming work items, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI automatically triage and prioritize incoming bugs and tasks

citations.quote: allowing teams to build custom AI agents that handle triaging, risk assessment, and task execution.
Build workflows with Wrike agents and let them handle your everyday tasks.
AI Essentials include AI content and editing, comment summary, board AI, mobile inbox prioritization, and NL automation rule generation.
